thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: unusual spike detected — 3.6M reqs / 5m to /v1/embeddings from 54.38.0.0/16, error rate creeping to 8%. Auto-scaler triggered twice. Paging oncall (raj).

raj: Acked. I'm on it. Looking at metrics now. Can someone drop the raw top-source IPs?

samantha: digging into logs. Looks like low-entropy API keys + heavy parallelism. Many requests have identical prompt prefix. Feels like a scraping farm trying to harvest embeddings.

eli: Confirming high fanout from a handful of /16s across multiple regions. Latency on embedding hosts up ~220ms p50 -> 430ms p50 now. Throughput pressure on redis KV cache too.

raj: Triage: mitigate traffic, protect customer experience. Proposed steps: 1) apply emergency per-IP rate limit (60r/s) at edge for anonymous/standard tier, 2) disable batch endpoint for unauth requests, 3) add WAF challenge (js/challenge) for suspect subnets, 4) notify CS for affected customers. Objections?

samantha: +1. Also recommend reduce per-key concurrent streams to 6 for standard tier while we investigate.

eli: Working on edge rule now. Pushing Cloudflare rule:

```bash
# blockish rule: challenge for netblocks seen in last 10m
curl -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$ZONE/firewall/rules" \
  -H "X-Auth-Email: infra@redwood.ai" \
  -H "X-Auth-Key: $CF_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '[{"filter": {"expression":"ip.src in {54.38.0.0/16 3.120.0.0/16}"}, "action":"challenge","description":"emergency-scraper-challenge"}]'
```

infra-bot: Deploy started: edge-rule/emergency-scraper-challenge by eli at 2024-05-20T15:21:12Z.

raj: Applied and live. Seeing challenge responses now. Traffic dropped ~48% from those nets. Good.

danielle: Noting customer impact: two self-serve customers reported slow embeddings earlier; both use shared (standard) keys. I'll prepare an outbound with the status and mitigation steps.

customer-eng: If we need to whitelist any paying customers, list them now. We should be conservative.

raj: Quick whitelist check: customer A (acct-345) uses dedicated key — unaffected. customer B (acct-998) on standard tier saw ~30% failed requests; flagged for priority support. Danielle pls follow up.

samantha: Next: rate-limit at API gateway for anonymous/standard tiers. Pushing token-bucket limits.

```json
# gateway patch (snippet)
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "limit": {
    "anonymous": "60/s",
    "standard": "120/s",
    "concurrent_per_key": 6
  }
}
```

infra-bot: Gateway policy update applied in 45s by samantha.

raj: Also disabling batching for unauthenticated calls. Command: `service deploy embeddings-api --disable-feature batching-unauth`

eli: Done. Batching disabled for unauth requests; verified via telemetry. Batch size med dropped to 1 for those flows.

raj: Monitoring. p50 latency back down near baseline; errors down to 1.2%. Good. Still seeing many retries from other proxies — adding short-lived quota cut for newly created keys (age <24h): limit to 5000 tokens/day.

samantha: Implemented rule in key-service. Snippet: `update-key-policy --filter "created_at<now-24h" --set daily_tokens=5000`

raj: Can we confirm downstream workers haven't backfilled too many tasks?

eli: Clearing backlog on worker queue `embeddings-workers-high`. Running: `kubectl exec -it qctl -- /app/drain --queue embeddings-workers-high --limit 2000`

infra-bot: Queue drain job started by eli. Estimated finish: 6m.

danielle: Customer comms draft: "We've detected abusive traffic impacting embeddings for a subset of customers. We've applied emergency throttles and WAF challenges which may affect traffic from some IP ranges. If you're experiencing degraded performance, reply and we'll prioritize." Want me to send?

raj: Send to affected accounts only after we confirm the set. Danielle go ahead in 10m. Tag paid customers as exceptions if needed.

customer-eng: Filing support ticket for acct-998, high priority.

raj: Ok team, plan for next 30m: monitor rate, watch for escalation. If traffic pivots to other nets, we flip to region-level shaping. Eli, be ready to enable region geo-rate-shaping.

eli: Ready. Command for geo-shape (example):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://edge-api.redwood.ai/v1/rate-shape" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d \
  '{"scope":"region:eu-west-1","limit":"1500r/m","policy":"shape"}'
```

raj: Handoff plan: I'm on-call for next 18 minutes; samantha will take the 6-hr shift after me. Leaving a quick runbook note here:

samantha: Taking over. I'll keep the challenge rule for 1h and re-evaluate. If error rate stays <2% and throughput recovers to baseline, we'll lift strict per-IP limits gradually: 60 -> 120 -> default.

raj: Leaving the thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident paged 5 users at 2024-05-20T15:21:05Z; severity: medium; status: mitigated -> monitoring.

samantha: NOTE FOR POST-MORTEM: capture why anonymous keys were created at scale (automation abuse?), evaluate adding friction to key creation (email verification / captcha), and add a metric for "unusual identical-prefix prompt" pattern to detect scraping attempts earlier.

eli: Also log exact WAF challenge fingerprint and reactions for tuning.

danielle: I'll draft the customer-facing summary and include recommended temporary workarounds for affected accounts.

customer-eng: Handoff accepted. Monitoring dashboard pinned in #incidents.
